bullets.title: ElevenLabs MCP now generates voice, music, SFX, images and video (50+ models), live in Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Hermes
bullets.summary: ElevenLabs' MCP connector covers TTS, Scribe STT (99 languages), dubbing, music, sound effects, image generation/editing, image-to-video and lipsync, saving outputs to an ElevenCreative workspace; the blog page (published Sep 14, last updated Nov 3, 2026) lists Hermes among supported clients. Not a last-24h launch; surfaced because it was the freshest verifiable media-generation MCP item.
bullets.how: The Construct: Hermes is a listed client, so voice/music/video generation can be wired in without custom glue; compare against Higgsfield. Brand 9 Signs: voiceover and music for social/product clips in the social-content flywheel. PRAGMA: a ready media-generation MCP to offer clients.

bullets.title: Claude Code 2.1.317-2.1.318: login-expiry warnings for claude -p and onFailure:"block" for Agent SDK hooks
bullets.summary: v2.1.318 (Nov 3) adds loginExpiresAt to `claude auth status` and makes `claude -p` warn 10 days before a claude.ai sign-in expires; v2.1.317 (Nov 2) adds onFailure:"block" for Agent SDK hook callbacks (blocks the action if the callback fails) and a gateway admin cost report endpoint (via havoptic.com aggregator, not the official changelog). Nothing newer than 2.1.319 (already covered Nov 8) found.
bullets.how: The Construct: the 10-day expiry warning protects unattended scheduled runs from silently losing auth; onFailure:"block" supports fail-closed hooks. PRAGMA: concrete hardening items for client unattended-agent setups. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Context: Cognition (Devin) raised $2B Series E at $48B valuation (reported Sep 9, 2026)
bullets.summary: A trade-press report says Cognition's run-rate revenue grew from $492M to nearly $900M since its May round, led by a16z and Accel, with enterprise customers named; figures are unverified and the item is two months old, included only as market context.
bullets.how: PRAGMA: evidence of enterprise demand for autonomous agents, useful in AI-operator pitches. The Construct: benchmark only. Brand 9 Signs: no.

praxis_lesson: Auth expiry is a silent failure mode for unattended agents: surface credential lifetimes (like Claude Code's 10-day sign-in warning) and fail closed with onFailure-style hooks, so a scheduled routine alerts you before it goes dark rather than after. (Caveat: quiet day — no verified new Anthropic model/skill/plugin, signage/CRM/DAM MCP, frontier-model, funding or arXiv items from the last 24h; web search returned link lists only, so items 1-3 are the freshest verifiable but not all new.)
